SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE
REPORT

File No.
SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE
C.I.D. General Office,
No. I. O. D. 1195.
Date April 24, 1930.
25 - 4 - 30.

Subject (in full) KOREAN COMMUNISTS ARRESTED BY FRENCH POLICE

Made by C.D.I. Nakagawa. Forwarded by

Sir,

With reference to the report published in the Shanghai
Mainichi under the above heading, I called on Mr. Obata, Chief
City Editor of the Shanghai Mainichi, and interrogated him as to
the correctness of the report. Mr. Obata, the Editor, stated,
that it was true that several Korean Communists were arrested on
or about April 16 by the French Police, but the statement to the
effect that An Chung Kun was the son of An Zoong Kun who assassi-
nated Prince Ito at Harbin was incorrect, for this man is said
to be living in Mankow at present. He refused to reveal the
source of information.

Mr. Hamasato, the Chief of Police of the Japanese Consulate-
General, states that he has not yet received any information from
the French Police.

S. Nakagawa
C.D.I.

|| French Police inform me
that there is no truth in the
report in the "Mainichi"

JR
Officer i/c Special Branch.

（批：J.C.B. and Sp. Branches）
Information. The incorrectness
of the Obata seems the likeliest.
J.R. 24:4:30

日期：1930年4月24日。
1930年4月25日。

主题（全称）：法国巡捕逮捕朝鲜共产党人

由刑事侦缉探员中川（Nakagawa）呈报。转呈

敬启者：

鉴于《上海每日新闻》（Shanghai Mainichi）刊登了上述标题的报道，本人拜访了《上海每日新闻》首席本市新闻编辑小畑（Obata）先生，就该报道的准确性向其进行查问。编辑小畑先生表示，法国巡捕确于4月16日左右逮捕了几名朝鲜共产党人，但称安重根（An Chung Kun）是曾在哈尔滨刺杀伊藤亲王（Prince Ito）的安重根（An Zoong Kun）之子，这一说法并不正确，因为据说此人目前居住在满洲（Mankow）。他拒绝透露消息来源。

日本驻上海总领事馆警务主任滨里（Hamasato）先生表示，他尚未从法国巡捕房收到任何消息。

S. 中川
刑事侦缉探员

|| 法国巡捕告知我
《每日新闻》的报道
并无事实依据

JR
特别科主管警官。

（批注：J.C.B. 及特别科）
情报。小畑（Obata）的说法似乎最有可能是不正确的。
J.R. 1930年4月24日

April 21, 1930. Morning Translation.

MISCELLANEOUS

ALLEGATION OF BRIBERY OF CHAPEI POLICE

The Shanghai Nippo publishes the following report:
At 3 p.m. yesterday a Japanese was arrested by a
Chapei policeman in Chinese territory near Dixwell Road
for riding a bicycle without Chinese licence but he was
released after placing one dollar in the hands of the
policeman.

KOREAN INSPECTORS INSTIGATE BUS STRIKE

(批：What ground has "mainichi" for this statement. H)
The Shanghai Mainichi publishes the following report:
The Korean ticket inspectors of the China General
Omnibus Co. are ostensibly quiet people but it is they
who are instigating the strike of Chinese employees of
the Bus Co. There are 48 Koreans in the employ of the
Co., some of whom are members of the branch of the Korean
communist party in China and are in a close touch with
Chinese communist party. The local Japanese Consulate
is keeping a close watch on them. There is a Korean
nationalist party which has nothing to do with the Korean
communist party and it is the nationalist party which is
helping the strikes.

KOREAN COMMUNISTS ARRESTED BY FRENCH POLICE

(批：Inquire if correct. H)
The Shanghai Mainichi publishes the following report:
At 2 p.m. April 16 a Korean named An Chang Kun, 31,
and 5 other Korean communists were arrested by the French
police. An is the son of An Keeng Kun who assassinated
Prince Ito at Harbin. He came to Shanghai some time
ago with his mother. In October of 1928 he was arrested
by the Japanese Consular police at a certain Hospital on
Carter Road but he was later released owing to his illness.
Since then he has become a communist. Recently he worked
with the Bus Company as a ticket inspector. He has also
been associating with an employee of a certain marble
shop on North Szechuen Road, an employee of a timber merchant
on Yangtsepo Road, with German Jews, Russian Jews, and
with members of the Third Internationale.

C.D. I. Nakagawa.

1930年4月21日。上午译件。

杂项

关于闸北警察受贿的指控

《上海日报》（Shanghai Nippo）刊登如下报道：
昨日下午3时，一名日本人因无中国执照骑自行车，在中国地界狄思威路（Dixwell Road）附近被一名闸北警察逮捕，但他将一美元塞入该警察手中后即获释放。

朝鲜籍查票员煽动公交车罢工

（批注：《每日新闻》有何依据作出此陈述。H）
《上海每日新闻》刊登如下报道：
中华汽车股份有限公司（China General Omnibus Co.）的朝鲜籍查票员表面上看似安分守己，但实际上正是他们在煽动该公司中国雇员罢工。该公司雇有48名朝鲜人，其中一些人是朝鲜共产党在华分支的成员，并与中国共产党保持密切联系。日本驻当地领事馆正对他们严加监视。存在一个与朝鲜共产党无关的朝鲜国民党，正是该国民党在支持此次罢工。

法国巡捕逮捕朝鲜共产党人

（批注：查询是否属实。H）
《上海每日新闻》刊登如下报道：
4月16日下午2时，一名名叫安昌坤（An Chang Kun）、31岁的朝鲜人及其他5名朝鲜共产党人被法国巡捕逮捕。安是曾在哈尔滨刺杀伊藤亲王的安重根（An Keeng Kun）之子。他不久前与母亲一同来到上海。1928年10月，他曾在卡特路（Carter Road）某医院被日本领事馆警察逮捕，但后因患病获释。此后他成为共产党人。最近他在公交车公司担任查票员。他还一直与北四川路某大理石店的一名雇员、杨树浦路（Yangtsepo Road）一家木材商的一名雇员、德籍犹太人、俄籍犹太人以及第三国际成员交往。

刑事侦缉探员 中川。
